finalists.label: Cholesteatoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including painless right otorrhea, a polypoid mass occluded the right external auditory canal with purulent discharge, and progressive hearing loss.

finalists.label: Middle ear cancer
finalists.why: It has the most comprehensive for evidence, including a polypoid mass, an irregularly enhancing mass on CT, erosive changes of the skull base, and profound sensorineural hearing loss.

finalists.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
finalists.why: It explains the sensation of the ear being shallower and the erosive changes on CT, but lacks direct evidence of a mass or discharge.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most decisive findings, including an irregularly enhancing mass on CT and erosive changes of the skull base, which are more specific to cancer than to other conditions.
